title: Free Image to Video AI – AI Video Generator from Images
excerpt: Use our Image to Video AI tool to animate photos online. This AI video generator from images lets you add motion prompts and create your first video for free.
content_html:
Portrait Images Animated Into Videos

Explore eight vertical video examples created from a single portrait and a short motion prompt.

See What You Can Create From a Still Image

Compare each source image, motion prompt, and generated video to see how a still visual becomes a moving scene.

A hand reaches into frame and lifts the chilled can toward the camera while dramatic studio light moves across its wet black surface.

A Simple Workflow for Turning Images Into Videos

Start with a clear source image, guide the motion and settings, then preview and download your finished video.

Start From a Strong Source Image

Upload a clear photo with a distinct subject. The model builds motion from what it can see, so well-lit portraits, products, and scenes usually produce more usable clips than busy or blurry images.

Upload and generate

Direct the Motion, Not Just the Look

Write a short prompt for subject movement, camera path, and mood. Then choose aspect ratio, resolution, duration, and frame rate before you spend credits—so you see the estimated cost up front.

Try image to video

Preview First, Then Download

Generate a clip, review the motion on the page, and download when it looks right. Use it for social posts, product demos, storyboards, or creative experiments—and regenerate with a clearer prompt if the first pass misses.

Create your first video

How to Turn an Image Into a Video With AI

Upload a source image, describe the motion, choose your output settings, then generate a video you can preview and download.

01

Upload an Image and Describe the Motion

Add a JPG, PNG, or WebP image, then write a prompt for the subject, camera, or scene movement you want to see.

02

Choose Your Video Settings

Select a video model, aspect ratio, 720p or 1080p, 5–20 second duration, and frame rate. The estimated credit cost updates before you generate.

03

Generate, Preview, and Download

Click Generate video and wait while your task is processed. Preview the finished clip on the page, then download it when you are ready.
